decisions.reason: The page 23 photo-crop adjustment does not alter the background treatment required for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
Adjusting the page 23 tree photo does not change the cover letter's page count, signature support, or overflow-photo handling.
The source requests only a localized photo-framing correction and does not change the full-document layout approach, coverage, or spacing.
The photo crop request neither changes the typography rules nor resolves the existing ambiguity about intentional bolding.
The requested tree visibility adjustment does not change the Blue Mesa brand identity or required brand elements.
The page 23 photo-framing correction has no effect on inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
The source does not revise the maximum page count or spacing policy; a slight zoom adjustment to one photo does not necessarily change page-limit compliance.
The photo-framing request does not change Canva editing access, ownership, or asset restrictions.
Changing the crop of the page 23 photograph does not alter the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
The page 23 photo-framing correction does not affect any table source, replacement, row count, or integration rule.
The tree-photo crop request does not change the biography count, affiliation, source, or population method.
The source concerns visual framing of an existing photograph and neither changes required section content nor resolves the outstanding content-inclusion ambiguity.
